name: Bashal'Aran
summary: Demonic satyrs and grells shun one shrine in Bashal'Aran, where an unearthly blue aura burns. Thundris Windweaver, Auberdine's elder, sends you to find its source.

sections.title: A Beacon in the Ruins
sections.body: Bashal'Aran once flourished under the ancient Kaldorei Empire. Now demonic taint fills its broken marble halls and overgrown arches. Twisted satyrs and corrupt grells feed on the ruins' lingering magic, growing more malicious by the day. Yet Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine has noticed a mystery: atop a western bluff, a blue aura shines above a shrine that no demon will approach.

sections.title: The Wounded Shade
sections.body: At the raised shrine, you find that the blue light comes from Asterion, an ancient spirit. The shade has kept its lonely vigil for centuries. Amid howling beasts and vile fiends, even a traveling stranger brings respite from decades of isolation.

faq.q: Where is the blue aura located?
faq.answer: The blue aura shines above a shrine atop a small raised bluff on Bashal'Aran's western edge, just east of Auberdine in Darkshore. The shrine rises slightly above the crumbling walls around it.

faq.q: Why do the satyrs avoid the shrine?
faq.answer: No one knows why the satyrs and grells avoid the shrine. A strange blue aura fills the place, and Thundris Windweaver sends you to find its source.

faq.q: Who sends you on this quest?
faq.answer: Thundris Windweaver, a night elf druid and Auberdine's elder, sends you after noticing unnatural demonic movements in the eastern ruins.
Bashal'Aran is an ancient kaldorei ruin in the forests of Darkshore, sacked during the ancient Sundering. Grells and satyrs now infest it, drawn by its dormant ley powers.

angles.text: As a night elf, Bashal'Aran recalls what your ancient kin lost in the Sundering. Their lingering shades keep lonely vigils as demonic corruption presses in.
As an Alliance wanderer, you help Auberdine's scouts push into Darkshore's contested ruins and keep demonic threats from reaching the coast.
